# Forge

Forge is a single-binary Go CLI (`github.com/teragrid/forge`) that wraps the
scan-fix-learn loop, an LLM gateway, a WASM plugin runtime, and a ship
workflow for AI-generated code. Run `forge` in any directory to add
production-grade quality gates, secret scanning, LLM spend controls, and a
tamper-proof audit trail to AI-vibe-coded projects.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): project overview, install, first-5-minutes walkthrough, all commands, FAQ
- [docs/AI_AGENT_GUIDE.md](docs/AI_AGENT_GUIDE.md): full agent reference — MCP tools, exact command syntax, exit codes, task patterns, error recovery
- [docs/INSTALLATION.md](docs/INSTALLATION.md): platform-by-platform install including non-interactive/CI one-liners
- [docs/VERBS.md](docs/VERBS.md): complete command (verb) reference with flags and error-code ranges
- [GETTING_STARTED.md](GETTING_STARTED.md): beginner walkthrough from zero to first `forge ship`
- [docs/ERROR_CODES.md](docs/ERROR_CODES.md): every FORGE-XXXX error code with cause and fix
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE_OVERVIEW.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE_OVERVIEW.md): internals, repo layout, design decisions
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): conventions for AI coding assistants working inside the forge codebase itself

## Quick capability map

| You want to… | Run |
|---|---|
| Install (one-shot, non-interactive) | `npm install -g @forgeone/cli` |
| Confirm everything is wired | `forge doctor` |
| Add Forge to an existing project | `forge init --minimal` |
| Scan for secrets | `forge scan secrets` |
| Scan for all issues | `forge scan all` |
| Run the full quality gate before a push | `forge ship` |
| Get an LLM-readable context bundle | `forge context generate` |
| Search the 172-entry knowledge base | `forge mcp serve` → tool `forge_kb_search` |
| Cap LLM spend | `forge spend set --daily 2.00 --monthly 30.00` |
| Read the audit log | `forge audit show` |
| Fix a bug | `forge bugfix --bug "<description>"` |
| Generate a 9-case test spec | `forge test spec "<feature>"` |
| Install Forge as an MCP server | `forge mcp info` (prints ready-to-paste configs) |
| Install expert-role skill files | `forge skill install --for all` |

## Install (one-liner)

```bash
# npm (recommended)
npm install -g @forgeone/cli

# go install
go install github.com/teragrid/forge/cmd/forge@latest

# curl (Linux amd64)
curl -Lo forge https://github.com/teragrid/forge/releases/latest/download/forge-linux-amd64 && chmod +x forge && sudo mv forge /usr/local/bin/
```

## MCP server (use Forge from your AI chat)

```jsonc
// VS Code — .vscode/settings.json (already present in this repo)
{ "mcp": { "servers": { "forge": { "type": "stdio", "command": "forge", "args": ["mcp", "serve"] } } } }

// Claude Desktop — ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json
{ "mcpServers": { "forge": { "command": "forge", "args": ["mcp", "serve"] } } }

// Cursor / Windsurf — run: forge mcp info  ← prints copy-paste config for every platform
```

MCP tools exposed:

| Tool name | Parameters | Returns |
|---|---|---|
| `forge_kb_search` | `{"query":"<text>","limit":<int>}` | JSON array of KB entries (title, body, tags, relevance) |
| `forge_get_workflow` | `{"verb":"<forge-verb>"}` | Markdown step-by-step workflow for that verb |
| `forge_get_standards` | `{}` | Contents of `.forge/instructions/*.md` + `AGENTS.md` |
| `forge_run` | `{"verb":"<verb>","args":[...]}` | Stdout + stderr of running `forge <verb> [args]` |

## Common agent task patterns

```bash
# Pattern: scan a project, report findings
forge scan all --json        # machine-readable JSON output

# Pattern: gate a push (non-interactive)
forge ship --dry-run         # exit 0 if all stages pass, 1 if any fail

# Pattern: fix a failing test
forge bugfix --test "TestName" --apply    # patches + regression test

# Pattern: generate a context snapshot for another LLM
forge context generate       # writes .forge/context/snapshot.md

# Pattern: verify audit integrity
forge audit verify           # exit 0 = untampered, 1 = hash mismatch

# Pattern: look up error code
forge ask error FORGE-1001   # plain-English cause + fix
```

## Exit codes

All forge verbs:
- **0** — success (no findings for scanners, all stages pass for `ship`)
- **1** — failure (findings present, stage failed, or bad arguments)
- **2** — fatal (binary misconfigured, missing dependency)

`forge scan *` exits 1 when findings are present even if `--exit-zero` is not set. Pass `--exit-zero` to always exit 0 (useful in advisory CI steps).

## Key file paths

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `forge.config.yml` | Project config (created by `forge init`) |
| `.forge/audit.log` | Hash-chained JSONL audit ledger |
| `.forge/context/snapshot.md` | LLM-readable project context |
| `.forge/instructions/*.md` | Project coding standards (read by `forge_get_standards`) |
| `.forge/specs/<feature>/spec.yml` | 9-case test spec (written by `forge test spec`) |
| `.forge/learned/gotchas.jsonl` | CI failure lessons |
| `AGENTS.md` | Coding-assistant instructions (in-repo conventions) |
